summary: Phase 5 passes acceptance on 67cc8ce1. The sheet script, both PNGs, and every gate meet AC5 and the plan claims. Three nonblocking record findings remain.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] phase-acceptance: scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs:361 writes the caption text `11/11 proportion rows pass; both palms face the legs` as a fixed string. The script never reads rows.*.pass or palms.*.ok from measure.json. The claim is true at this HEAD: 11 rows pass, both palms are ok, and no guard fails. A later failed measurement would still print a passing caption, and tests/mom-kim-sheet.adversarial.test.ts:138 pins the same string. Fix: build the line from measure.json. Rationale: AC5 rule 6 asks for the pass table result, and a fixed string is not a result.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md:705-719 names F1 as the transparent Kim sheet and F2 as the rows.lit validation. adversarial-p5-2451d2c.json names them the other way: F1 is rows.lit and F2 is the transparent Kim sheet. The comments at scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs:197 and :267 follow the plan labels. Both defects are fixed and tested, so only the trace from the plan to the audit record is wrong. Fix: relabel the plan text or add a cross-reference. Rationale: a reader who follows F1 from the plan lands on the wrong finding.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md:316-321 records the F6 and F7 ruling but gives no debt row text for them. The Phase 2 row (plan.md:299) and the out/ lesson (plan.md:321) have candidate text. measure/tech-debt.md holds 50 lines, which is its limit, and no row for F6 or F7. The tests are skipped at tests/mom-kim-sheet.adversarial-r3.test.ts:64 and :103. The record also lacks the contract form `Late finding <id>: tech-debt (<reason>)` (references/contracts.md:180). Fix: add the row text and the contract lines before the merge to master. Rationale: the debt exists only in this plan and in the skip titles.
